text:
Type: grey adjustable floor reading lamp
Use: reading light beside an armchair, sofa or desk; living room, home office, bedroom
Style: industrial, retro, Scandinavian
Materials: grey lacquered steel shade, arm and pole, round metal base
Colors: medium grey, silver joints
Shape: small bell shade on a long two-part jointed arm that reaches out from a tall slim pole, round flat base, mechanical architect style, light and open
Feel: practical, focused, studious, vintage
Goes with: grey or white walls, light wood, leather armchairs; industrial, retro or Scandinavian living rooms and studies

product.name: ARD
product.description: You can easily direct the light where you want it because the lamp arm and head are adjustable.
